data.name: Behsa
data.gender_notes: Behsa is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Behsa is derived from the Persian language, meaning 'bringer of joy' or 'radiant'. In Islamic culture, it is associated with the joy and happiness that comes from following the teachings of Allah and leading a righteous life. The name Behsa carries the meaning “Joyful, Radiant” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Behsa usually hope their child will grow to embody joyful, radiant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name filled with joy and radiance, reflecting the inner peace and contentment that comes from living in accordance with Islamic values.
data.etymology: Behsa belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Joyful, Radiant.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Behsa total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
